Answer: C
Reason: The frontal chest X-ray (Figure 1a) shows two distinct nodules indicated by arrows: one in the right middle lobe obscuring the right heart border and another retrocardiac nodule on the left. This specific finding, often associated with a mosaic attenuation pattern on CT (implied by the diagnosis), is characteristic of Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH).
